internal_wires.scope: Prescribed cable paths between nominal anchors. No TPU or real swivel response.

simultaneous_equilibrium.scope: Shoulder neutral. Rigid parts and taut cables; friction and TPU loads omitted.

tracked_swivels.scope: Each swivel tracks projected incoming direction while the other is neutral. Rigid checks stop at first hit per pack. Equilibrium unverified.

coupled.scope: Rigid forearm and revised proximal fittings, plus prescribed elbow cables versus stationary shoulder solids.

revised_elbow_motion.scope: Nominal rigid elbow rotation, distal swivels held neutral, shoulder fixed. No TPU deformation.

scope: Local fit and rigid insertion with corrected TPU, cap and two elbow adapters. Fixation and remaining parts excluded.
